description: Fires mainly in early-to-middle game positions where column 4 (right of center) holds exactly one stone, so the next stone there lands on row 1, especially when the opponent has stones beside it on the bottom row (cols 2/3/5) and columns 0 and 6 are empty. A second case is the opponent having three stacked in column 4. My own stone beside or on top of the col-4 stone switches it off. Most positions matching this still do not fire.
effect: Small: forcing it to zero changes move probabilities by under 0.1; in two strong positions zeroing raised column 2 by about 6-8 points. Otherwise none measurable.
notes: Col4-height-1 alone: F1 0.19, AUROC 0.73. Neighbour/ply/edge refinements never pushed precision above ~0.14; best F1 0.212 (sim share 0.12). Minimal pairs show strong but irregular dependence on single distant stones (e.g. opponent stone in col 1 or col 6 kills it), not a clean tactical concept; it is likely a diffuse or mixed direction. Rejected: last move stacking on own stone; pure heights profile; mirror symmetry.
